### 🔵 Needs a closer look

The updated workflow contains confirmed logic/diagnostic bugs that can prevent re-request retries and/or erase the error output the timeout path claims it will report.

<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

### Suppressed comments (3)

**.github/workflows/copilot-review-gate.yml:232**
* The re-request logic won’t retry if `gh pr edit --add-reviewer` fails: `reported` is advanced before the edit attempt, so `refused > reported` will never be true again for the same `refused` count, and no further request is made even though `MAX_REREQUESTS` budget remains. This can leave the gate waiting out the full window without ever successfully re-requesting a review.
```
            # Only when the count moves — otherwise a 15-minute wait prints the
            # same line thirty times and buries the one that matters.
            if [ "${refused:-0}" -gt "${reported:-0}" ]; then
              echo "Copilot answered $refused time(s) without reviewing."
              reported=$refused
```
**.github/workflows/copilot-review-gate.yml:214**
* `gh pr edit` appends its stderr to `$api_err` (`2>>`), but the subsequent `gh api` call truncates the same file each poll (`2>`). That can erase the re-request failure you intend to print on timeout, making the timeout diagnostics incomplete/misleading.
```
              2>"$api_err") || kinds=""
```
**.github/workflows/copilot-review-gate.yml:185**
* This comment block talks about “a run triggered by a review”, but this workflow’s `on:` only includes `pull_request` (no `pull_request_review`). That makes the rationale confusing and suggests behavior that cannot occur for this workflow as written.
```
          # Only a push has something to wait FOR. A run triggered by a review
          # already has its answer sitting in the API, so it classifies once and
          # reports — it must not open a second waiting window. Otherwise a
          # review arriving mid-wait queues a run behind the current one, that
          # run starts a fresh 15 minutes when the first times out, and a PR
```
